dedupe_keys.name: arcep mon reseau mobile open data mobile coverage sites and quality of service

description: Mon Réseau Mobile is the map platform of the French telecom regulator Arcep that compares mobile operators, and this dataset publishes all of its underlying data: theoretical coverage maps of 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G voice and data for each operator in several signal levels, the lists of mobile sites with their technologies (including sites of the targeted coverage scheme and the New Deal mobile commitments), and the results of Arcep's field measurement campaigns of voice, SMS and data quality of service, with crowdsourced measurements from partner applications. Operators produce the coverage maps under their licence obligations and Arcep checks them by field audits. Coverage: metropolitan France and overseas territories, map polygons at fine resolution and point measurements, quarterly releases since 2017 with the current files covering the latest year. Format and access: CSV tables and GeoPackage coverage layers downloadable from data.gouv.fr, with the map viewer at monreseaumobile.arcep.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Caveats: coverage maps are modelled, not measured, and differ from experienced service indoors; measurement campaigns sample selected places and dates; the viewer did not answer the shell on 2026-09-26. Simulation uses: service areas of mobile networks for hazard exposure and resilience studies, network planning, and service performance baselines for emergency communications. Related records: ANFR radio installations give site equipment, Arcep unavailable sites give daily outages, and OpenCelliD gives crowdsourced cell locations.
